name: quipier-docs
description: Quipier docs site + SDK playground (docs.quipier.com; playground at /example)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-docs.mjs
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env prod
